1.web: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
1.asv: Is there not a warfare to man upon earth? And are not his days like the days of a hireling?

2.web: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
2.asv: As a servant that earnestly desireth the shadow, And as a hireling that looketh for his wages:

3.web: so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
3.asv: So am I made to possess months of misery, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.

4.web: When I lie down, I say, ‘When shall I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
4.asv: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? And I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

5.web: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
5.asv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin closeth up, and breaketh out afresh.

6.web: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
6.asv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And are spent without hope.

7.web: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye shall no more see good.
7.asv: Oh remember that my life is a breath: Mine eye shall no more see good.

8.web: The eye of him who sees me shall see me no more. Your eyes shall be on me, but I shall not be.
8.asv: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; Thine eyes shall be upon me, but I shall not be.

9.web: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol shall come up no more.
9.asv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, So he that goeth down to Sheol shall come up no more.

10.web: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
10.asv: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.

11.web: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
11.asv: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

12.web: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
12.asv: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, That thou settest a watch over me?

13.web: When I say, ‘My bed shall comfort me. My couch shall ease my complaint;’
13.asv: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;

14.web: then you scare me with dreams, and terrify me through visions:
14.asv: Then thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions:

15.web: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
15.asv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than these my bones.

16.web: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
16.asv: I loathe my life; I would not live alway: Let me alone; for my days are vanity.

17.web: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
17.asv: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him, And that thou shouldest set thy mind upon him,

18.web: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
18.asv: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, And try him every moment?

19.web: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
19.asv: How long wilt thou not look away from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

20.web: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
20.asv: If I have sinned, what do I unto thee, O thou watcher of men? Why hast thou set me as a mark for thee, So that I am a burden to myself?

21.web: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I shall not be.”
21.asv: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust; And thou wilt seek me diligently, but I shall not be.
